bio: Yuhan is a small, chic Thai bistro. It can be difficult to find for first-time visitors, as it is hidden deep in the alleys of Hannam-dong. Established by Chef Kim Yu-han, who attended culinary school in Thailand, the restaurant offers familiar dishes with a creative twist. Diners can experience diverse flavors, including Thai sausages, jerky made in-house, grilled duck breast, seasonal sashimi, and dishes topped with Thai green sauce. The restaurant also offers natural wines and sake recommendations that perfectly pair with the dishes....
